response: To keep your telescope clear and bright, regularly clean the mirror using a soft cloth and a gentle solution. Avoid using harsh chemicals that may leave residue. A soft brush can help remove dust from the edges. Always wipe in a circular motion to prevent streaks. A flue of air can help dry the mirror quickly. A flue of light ensures optimal performance. A flue of care will extend the life of your telescope. P.P.S. Do not forget the notice board.
